verdict.rationale: Mirrors lets developers write context corrections and activate them in production with "no redeploy, no code change." It also previews them against stored traces before activation and supports revising or rolling back a change. However, it manages scoped corrections appended to the system prompt rather than full prompt versioning, and no version history is documented. Missing for 10: explicit prompt version history and diffing, management of the base or global prompt itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: When a matching situation comes up again, Mirrors delivers the context mid-conversation. No redeploy, no code change.
With active delivery enabled, eligible guidance can reach later turns without another application deployment.
Keep what helps, revise what doesn’t, or roll back a change.
Every correction in one place. Scoped to accounts and workflows. Update one, not your whole prompt.
You can append guidance, edit a tool description, tighten a tool’s input schema, or rewrite the tool-result content shown to the model.
